This can be used to read another file.

shell.comment: The optional `reset` command is needed to receive the echo back of the typed keystrokes.

shell.code:
echo '[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/path/to/command
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target' >/path/to/temp-file.service
systemctl link /path/to/temp-file.service
systemctl enable --now /path/to/temp-file.service
shell.comment: It might happen that the service is not started with `--now`, in such cases it might be necessary to manually start it.

shell.code:
echo /bin/sh >/path/to/temp-file
chmod +x /path/to/temp-file
SYSTEMD_EDITOR=/path/to/temp-file systemctl edit basic.target
